notes.title: SPYHACK is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear Spies! 

SPYHACK: Episode 1 is now available on Steam! Play NOW and become a secret agent of the Advanced Technology Division to protect humanity from self-destruction!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/b87d1f555da8647161954d197dd2ac50a664b9c6.png

To celebrate SpyHack release on Steam, we have a small surprise for you on our Discord server, so be sure to to join us! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png 

If you encounter bugs, please report them on Steam Forum or on our Discord server. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/2f315b41b3f917d984c518d23180ef1ee5b2c3a8.png

Remember that you can also play the full version of this game on Nintendo Switch!

Play now and have fun! 
SpyHack Team 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/687340/SPYHACK_Episode_1/

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Spies! 

We are happy to announce that SpyHack is coming to Steam on 4th of December! Get ready to become a secret agent of the Advanced Technology Division and protect humanity from self-destruction! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/b87d1f555da8647161954d197dd2ac50a664b9c6.png

Remember that you can already play the full version of this game on Nintendo Switch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/2f315b41b3f917d984c518d23180ef1ee5b2c3a8.png

Feel free to join our Discord server, where you can talk about the game and post your suggestions! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png

SpyHack Team

notes.title: Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition!
notes.content:
Dear Spies!

The Steam game festival starts today:  Oct 7th, and will last up to Oct 13th! If you haven’t tried out SpyHack Demo yet, you do this now! Play the demo and have fun! 

SpyHack Demo is a small introduction to the world ruled by unethical technocorporations. Become a secret agent and protect humanity from self-destruction!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/b53b02c0273853c26441c73d4d6648841168016f.jpg

How to download a demo?

You will be able to download the demo from our Steam Page SpyHack steam store page. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/687340/SPYHACK_Episode_1/


During the Steam Game Festival, you may expect a stream with chat and more! 
More information will follow in a few days so stay tuned! ːsteamhappyː

SpyHack Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/938110dec635bbbb24a7edc43d13a925d27a684b.png

notes.title: Open beta tests!
notes.content:
We are launching SPYHACK: Episode 1 Open Beta Tests subscription!

In order to participate in the open beta you need to:

 Follow the game on Steam
 Add the game to WishList on Steam
 Submit your email in the form: https://goo.gl/forms/NCGnyNWAfbXVa00u2
